patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopify and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Shopify only if your buying job matches “Hosted SaaS ecommerce platform with themes, checkout, channels, and POS — Basic from $39/m” rather than Shopware's shape. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Shopify's shape. Workflow advantage: Shopify leans checkout-conversion, omnichannel-retail; Shopware leans wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopify and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Shopify is Hosted SaaS ecommerce platform with themes, checkout, channels, and POS — Basic from $39/mo ($29 annual), Grow $105 ($79 annual), Advanced $; Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote..
- Company-size focus: Shopify (solo, micro, small-business) vs Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Shopify-leaning checkout-conversion, omnichannel-retail vs Shopware-leaning wholesale-b2b.
- Researched limits: Shopify — Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price; Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV.

Limitations — Shopify: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price; Third-party payment gateways incur additional transaction fees on lower tiers; Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting.

Poor-fit cases: Shopify is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price · Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Avoid Shopify if you actually need Shopware's motion (Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Ris)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
